	["Sky Pole"]={name="Sky Pole", internal_id=3, desc="A small smart drone that has multiple functions, like scouting and surveillance."},

	["Precursor"]={name="Precursor", internal_id=5, desc="An ancient interstellar civilization destroyed by unknown causes. The legacy they left behind allowed the modern human civilization to thrive."},

	["Aurora"]={name="Aurora", internal_id=7, desc="A special phenomenon near the North Pole. It is actually a wall-like barrier encircling an entire zone and comprises an unending series of Æther energy ruptures. 	["Feranmut"]={name="Feranmut", internal_id=8, desc="Gargantuan creatures indigenous to Terra. They measure anywhere from several hundred meters to several hundred kilometers in size. Feranmuts wield supernatural powers that are completely unrelated to Originium Arts."},
	["Miasma Gas"]={name="Miasma Gas", internal_id=9, desc="A gaseous form of Blight that behaves like fog and mist with very ill-defined boundaries. Masses of Blight Miasma are usually found in the North Wuling Exclusion Zone."},
	["Bell of Three Presences"]={name="Bell of Three Presences", internal_id=10, desc="An ancient Yanese bell modified using Xiranite. Such bells are usually placed near key infrastructure as they can detect the presence of Blight and automatically sound alarms to alert people nearby."},
	["Howlerbeast"]={name="Howlerbeast", internal_id=11, desc="A beast indigenous to Talos-II that can reach great sizes. They have unique vocal cords that allow adult howlerbeasts to injure their enemies by howling. This special way of attacking gave rise to their name: howlerbeasts."},
	["Talos"]={name="Talos", internal_id=12, desc="A gas giant with visible rings. Talos-II, the world in which we live, is its second moon. Under most circumstances, the gas giant is conspicuously visible in the sky."},
	["La Fantoma"]={name="La Fantoma", internal_id=13, desc="The city where the Talos-II General Chamber of Commerce is headquartered in. This coastal cosmopolis is known for its warmth, passion, points of interest, and pop music."},
	["Luoyi"]={name="Luoyi", internal_id=14, desc="An important transport hub of Hongshan Academy of Sciences (HAS). It is the earliest major city built after the establishment of HAS Headquarters."},
	["Fowlbeast"]={name="Fowlbeast", internal_id=15, desc="The fowlbeast (fowl) is a general term for describing any oviparous vertebrate beast covered in feathers."},
	["Very Large Rift"]={name="Very Large Rift", internal_id=16, desc="The largest rift known in the Civilization Band."},
	["Proxy"]={name="Proxy", internal_id=17, desc="The avatar that a Feranmut uses to travel in the mortal world."},
	["North Wuling Exclusion Zone"]={name="North Wuling Exclusion Zone", internal_id=18, desc="The Exclusion Zone used to be the Wuling Science Station. After a disaster ten years ago, the entire area became ruins filled with the Blight."},
	["Blightshade"]={name="Blightshade", internal_id=19, desc="A replicate of a victim killed by the Æther. Such Æther copies can act independently and are extremely aggressive."},
	["Yinglung Pass"]={name="Yinglung Pass", internal_id=20, desc="A complex of containment facilities constructed to hold back the Wuling Very Large Rift. The Pass is now garrisoned by the Yinglung Special Task Force."},
